title: Raytheon and CET Successfully Test New Low-Cost Hadalus UUV for U.S. Navy
summary: Raytheon and Composite Energy Technologies (CET) have successfully demonstrated the Hadalus, a new low-cost, long-endurance unmanned undersea vehicle (UUV). During a U.S. Navy test, the Hadalus proved its submerged launch and autonomous mission capabilities.

title: DARPA developing hypersonic cruise missile to evade enemy air defenses
summary: DARPA is actively developing a new hypersonic cruise missile. This initiative is a direct response to Pentagon concerns regarding the vulnerability of current American missiles to advanced enemy air defense systems, aiming to create a missile capable of evading detection and interception.

title: US Navy tests AI-powered submarine hunter
summary: The U.S. Navy successfully tested artificial intelligence-powered sonar technology designed to target submarines. This test was conducted during the multinational Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) exercise, demonstrating advanced capabilities in anti-submarine warfare.

title: Marine Corps to get ‘production-ready’ microwave drone swarm killer

title: USS Theodore Roosevelt becomes first carrier with built-in Unmanned Air Warfare Center
